title: Monthly Membership with Raku Access
source_quote: B-Mix w/Grog B-Mix with added tooth for bigger builds, and one of our two picks for raku.
evidence_sentence: The membership pages mention raku workshops as part of the Clay Hole offering and recommend specific clay bodies for raku work.
evidence_quote: B-Mix with added tooth for bigger builds, and one of our two picks for raku.
how_to_join: Join at one of four membership levels ($145–$275/month), all include access to workshops and events such as raku firings.
summary: Monthly memberships at all levels include access to studio classes and workshops like raku firings. Bisque and glaze firings cost extra per piece.
cost_text: $145–$275/month depending on level; glaze firings cost 5 cents per cubic inch ($4.80 minimum), bisque free.
pay_text: Monthly membership fee; glaze firing cost per cubic inch.
